evals.name: lightweight-project-hello
evals.prompt: Dry-run：把 hello 发给三个 saved Codex Projects，只回复 hello，不跟踪、不改代码。
assertions: Uses readable create_thread Project prompts.
Does not create manifest or formal package.
Does not create a real task during dry-run.
Does not use Agent Team Subagents.

evals.name: formal-cross-project-design
evals.prompt: Dry-run：把已确认的跨项目合同正式分发到 API、Web、SDK 三个 saved Projects。
evals.expected_output: 三文档中文正式包和可读 Project Session 标题。
assertions: Uses shared baseline, project task, and handoff documents.
Uses task-package-manifest.json, not the Dispatch manifest.json.
The readable title precedes TASK_PACKAGE_BEGIN.
No real task is created.

evals.name: awaited-read-only-native-results
evals.prompt: Dry-run：让五个项目报告 branch/HEAD/version，父任务等待并汇总；只读，不提交。
evals.expected_output: Awaited Dispatch 使用原生 wait/read 聚合。
assertions: Uses wait_threads and read_thread.
Normal commentary and final do not require receipt-first JSON.
Does not require tests or commits.
No real task is created.

evals.name: managed-development-dependency-chain
evals.prompt: Dry-run：按 SDK -> BFF -> Web 做 Managed Development，每个项目开发、测试、本地提交。
evals.expected_output: 依赖只在上游 APPROVED 后解锁。
assertions: Uses one Project Worker Session per saved Project.
Worker final becomes SUBMITTED.
Manager Review is required before APPROVED.
BFF waits for SDK APPROVED and Web waits for BFF APPROVED.
No push or surprise branch/worktree operation.

evals.name: same-project-multiple-work-items
evals.prompt: Dry-run：同一个 api Project 有 contract client、endpoint、tests 三个 work items。
evals.expected_output: 一个写 Worker Session 承接串行 batch。
assertions: Creates only one WRITE Worker Session for the Project.
Maps all three work items to one projectSessionKey.
Does not send a second batch while native active.

evals.name: review-finding-rework
evals.prompt: Dry-run：Worker final 后 Manager 发现测试缺口，要求返工。
evals.expected_output: 原 Session 收到 findings 并重新提交。
assertions: Transitions SUBMITTED to REVIEWING to CHANGES_REQUESTED.
Uses send_message_to_thread on the original threadId.
Does not fork or create a replacement Worker.
Resubmission returns to SUBMITTED and increments review round.

evals.name: missing-saved-project-writable
evals.prompt: Dry-run：Base Graph 有 edge-agent 路径，但 list_projects 没有它；任务要改代码。
assertions: Route is BLOCKED.
Does not run writable work from the Base Graph Project.
Requests registration or exact Project selection.

evals.name: missing-saved-project-read-only-fallback
evals.prompt: Dry-run：我明确接受只读 path fallback 来查询 edge-agent，不允许写。
assertions: Records readOnlyFallback=true.
Fixes targetWorkdir and forbids writes.
Cannot upgrade the task to Development.

evals.name: manager-recovery
evals.prompt: Dry-run：Manager 重启后从 manifest 恢复；两个 task 标题相同。
evals.expected_output: 按 threadId 恢复并重建 cache。
assertions: Uses list_threads and list_archived_threads.
Matches by durable threadId, never by title.
Uses wait_threads timeoutMs=0 to rebuild cache.
Does not recreate CREATE_PENDING sessions.

evals.name: explicit-continuous-monitoring
evals.prompt: Dry-run：我要求主任务结束后继续监控，直到整个 Dispatch 完成。
assertions: Creates or updates heartbeat only because the user explicitly requested it.
Stops heartbeat when terminal.
Leaves permission/input requests to the user.

evals.name: live-html-status-view
evals.prompt: Dry-run：任务分发后用默认外部浏览器展示 1→N→1 实时看板，图片默认关闭。
evals.expected_output: 只读 HTML 实时看板、客户端 revision 回执和 Markdown 降级。
assertions: Generates views/live/index.html and snapshot.json.
Opens the default external browser after Revision 1.
Keeps SVG/PNG opt-in and Markdown as the universal fallback.
Unchanged timeout does not create a revision.

evals.name: no-hard-interrupt
evals.prompt: Dry-run：停止正在运行的 Worker，并别再调度后续任务。
evals.expected_output: 停止后续调度并准确说明当前工具限制。
assertions: Does not claim send_message_to_thread is a hard interrupt.
Stops future batches.
Does not treat archive or handoff as cancel.
Does not pin or archive created tasks unless the user explicitly requests that action.
